newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish share close higher but without commitment.
newsitem.headline: Swedish share close higher but without commitment.

text.p: Sweden's sharemarket gained in Wednesday trade following rises in New York overnight but dealers said the market lacked commitment.
The Stockholm general index crept up 0.32 percent to 2156.86 after shares worth 2.8 billion crowns were traded.
But brokers said the market lacked any strong direction and said there was an element of hesitancy in the market.
"Investors dislike uncertainty and for the time being seem reluctant to take any real decision in any paper," said one broker.
The drugs sector posted highest gains, rising 1.04 percent.
Drugs major Astra rose 3.5 crowns to 295.50 crowns after strong gains on Wall Street while Pharmacia & Upjohn climbed 2.5 to 249.5 crowns.
Forestry company MoDo had an active day after posting a better-than-expected profit for the first nine months of 1996. It closed 3.5 crowns up at 181 crowns, off a day's high of 186 crowns.
Industrial company Incentive also posted its nine month report on Wednesday. It rose one crown to 398 crowns.
Bluechip telecoms giant Ericsson edged up 0.5 to 193 crowns.
